Freelancer - Instant Fails?
Hey guys, I apologise if this has been asked before but I couldn't find it. I'm still fairly new to freelancer however I've come across maybe a bugged spawn? I started in the middle of Hokkaido in the spa part, with 47 relaxing in the chair. And as soon as I got up from the chair, everyone instantly spotted me and was engaged in combat.

I barely managed to survive the encounter but obviously didn't do well in the mission. Is there anyway to get past this without alerting everyone?
